Polygon Array.js

hello.

I post another polygon script (scripts/Polygonobj folder) to make copy polygon-mesh at another object's surfaces. I hope it'd be help for modeling. :smile: 

update - 20070519: added new parameter for random position.
update - 20081120: fixed UV error for 4.6+.
update - 20100119: now support multi children copy and some options added.

download -> http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=28
